meta.name: coinpaprika-api
meta.description: Access cryptocurrency market data from CoinPaprika: prices, tickers, OHLCV, exchanges, contract lookups for 12,000+ coins and 350+ exchanges. Free tier, no API key needed. Install MCP: add https://mcp.coinpaprika.com/sse as SSE server, or install plugin: /plugin marketplace add coinpaprika/claude-marketplace

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询加密货币市场数据，包括价格、行情和交易所信息
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要获取加密货币实时价格和历史行情数据
copy.tagline_en: Query cryptocurrency market data including prices, tickers, and exchange info
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need real-time crypto prices and historical market data

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以查询加密货币的实时价格、市值、交易量、历史K线、交易所信息等，覆盖12000多种币和350多个交易所。
howto.when: 当你询问加密货币价格、市值、历史数据或交易所信息时触发。

say.text: 比特币当前价格是多少？
say.note: Claude 会调用 API 获取 BTC 最新价格。

say.text: 以太坊最近7天的K线数据
say.note: Claude 会获取 ETH 的 OHLCV 历史数据。

say.text: 帮我查一下币安交易所的现货交易对
say.note: Claude 会查询币安的市场信息。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can query real-time cryptocurrency prices, market cap, volume, historical OHLCV data, exchange info, and more, covering 12,000+ coins and 350+ exchanges.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about cryptocurrency prices, market cap, historical data, or exchange information.

say_en.text: What is the current price of Bitcoin?
say_en.note: Claude will call the API to get the latest BTC price.

say_en.text: Show me the 7-day candlestick data for Ethereum.
say_en.note: Claude will fetch OHLCV historical data for ETH.

say_en.text: List the spot trading pairs on Binance.
say_en.note: Claude will query Binance market info.
